aeo_summary: This ready-to-move residential enclave sits just off the Meerut Bypass in the NCR’s eastern belt, offering everyday essentials like power backup, security, water supply, green spaces, indoor games, and a children’s play zone. The address suits end-users seeking quick possession and investors banking on the Delhi–Meerut growth corridor and improving civic upgrades.

sections.who_is_it_for:
The offering focuses on the essentials and a few lifestyle touches—sensible for buyers who prioritise move-in readiness over club-heavy developments. Expect a kids’ play zone, indoor recreation, round-the-clock security, power backup, assured water supply, and landscaped greens for daily walks and community time.

Amenity snapshot

| Category     | Highlights                               |
|--------------|------------------------------------------|
| Convenience  | Power backup; assured water supply       |
| Safety       | 24x7 security                            |
| Outdoors     | Central green / community park           |
| Family       | Children’s play area                     |
| Leisure      | Indoor games                             |

Note: Specific clubhouse or sports-court inventories are not advertised; buyers should verify on-site during inspection.

Citations: Square Yards project page.

Price: Not disclosed publicly in the data reviewed; expect price-on-request. Seek an all-inclusive quote covering base value, parking, corner/facing/location charges (if any), power backup, club/maintenance corpus, and statutory levies.

Plan for these typical heads in Uttar Pradesh:
- Stamp duty and registration: As per IGRSUP norms at the time of registration (check the official portal for current rates and any local rebates).
- GST: Generally not applicable to completed/ready properties; under-construction housing attracts 1% (affordable) or 5% (other) without ITC under current regime—verify applicability to your unit and stage (CBIC FAQs).
- Association and maintenance: One-time corpus, monthly CAM, and facility charges based on the final amenity handover.


Citations: IGRSUP (Uttar Pradesh Stamps & Registration); CBIC Real Estate FAQs.

Promoter details are not explicitly disclosed in the source dataset. Before committing:
- Validate sanctioned plans with the local development authority and match them to what’s delivered on-site.
- Check handover quality through resident feedback and a professional snagging report if possible.

Regions of operation: Local delivery patterns suggest a NCR–western UP focus for comparable schemes in and around the Indraprastha Yojana belt. Notable recognitions: None independently verified for this promoter as of writing.

faq.question: Is this a freehold development?
faq.answer: Land tenure varies by pocket and scheme. Ask for the title chain, land-use certificate, and sale deed draft; have a property lawyer confirm freehold status before token payment.

faq.question: Are pets allowed inside the community?
faq.answer: Most NCR housing societies allow pets with by-laws on leash use, noise, and common area hygiene. Request the society’s current house rules or Model By-Laws before moving in.

faq.question: What kind of power backup is provided?
faq.answer: The project lists power backup among core conveniences. Confirm the DG capacity, coverage (common areas vs. inside units), and per-unit backup load during the site visit.

faq.question: Is municipal water available year-round?
faq.answer: The listing cites 24x7 water supply. In practice, availability often blends municipal and on-site storage/booster systems. Check supply source, storage capacity, and pressure at top floors.

faq.question: How close is public transit?
faq.answer: Road access is immediate via the bypass. The Delhi–Ghaziabad–Meerut RRTS priority section up to Duhai Depot is operational, improving regional connectivity (NCRTC). Verify last-mile options from the site.

faq.question: What extra costs should buyers expect beyond the base price?
faq.answer: Budget for stamp duty and registration (per IGRSUP), documentation charges, any PLC/parking, society corpus, monthly CAM, and GST if applicable to your unit’s construction stage (CBIC).

faq.question: Can I get bank home-loan approval for this property?
faq.answer: Most lenders require clear title, approvals, and (if applicable) valid RERA registration. Share the document set with your preferred bank for a preliminary credit and legal appraisal.
